title: Scheme tests and field-extension lifts for a pulled-back sheaf family
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Work with sheaves of sets on its big fppf site [def-pc-fppf-site, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $g:G\to H$ and $h_i:H_i\to H$ for $i\in I$ be natural transformations. For each $i$ define the pointwise presheaf $P_i(T)=\{(x,y)\in G(T)\times H_i(T):g(x)=h_i(y)\}$, with projection $\pi_i:P_i\to G$. Assume each $h_i$ is representable etale in the scheme-test convention [def-trf-algebraic-space]. For every $S$-scheme $T$ and $t:h_T\to G$, there is a canonical isomorphism $h_T\times_GP_i\cong h_T\times_HH_i$, where the map $h_T\to H$ is $g\circ t$. The right side is represented by a scheme etale over $T$. Consequently each $\pi_i$ is representable etale; if $G=h_T$ is represented by a scheme, $P_i$ is represented by a scheme. Suppose also that $(h_i)_{i\in I}$ is jointly surjective on field-valued point classes [def-trf-algebraic-space-jointly-surjective-family]. Then for every field $K$ [def-weil-field], $s:\operatorname{Spec}K\to S$, and $x\in G(\operatorname{Spec}K,s)$, there exist $i\in I$, a field extension $e:K\to M$, and $y\in H_i(\operatorname{Spec}M,s\circ\operatorname{Spec}e)$ with $h_i(y)=g(x)|_M$; the pair $(x|_M,y)$ belongs to $P_i(\operatorname{Spec}M)$ and projects to $x|_M$. Thus $(\pi_i)_{i\in I}$ is jointly surjective on point classes. This assertion includes $I=\varnothing$: its hypothesis forces $G$ to have no field-valued points.

proof.text: Evaluate the explicit compatible-pair cone at each test scheme. Its vertex and both projections are definitionally Mathlib Types.pullbackCone for the evaluated maps. Transport Types.pullbackLimitCone.isLimit along the identity cospan comparison and the identity cone isomorphism. Mathlib evaluationJointlyReflectsLimits then proves the presheaf cone limiting, including its naturality and uniqueness. Apply Mathlib closure of the sheaf property under limits to the cospan of sheaves G, H_i, H, using their sheaf-condition proofs [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. This also includes empty covers.

proof.text: Fix i, T/S and t:h_T→G. Paste the explicit pullback square for t and P_i→G horizontally with the explicit square for G→H and H_i→H, taking the flipped squares. The resulting square exhibits h_T×_G P_i as the pullback of t≫g and h_i. The explicit h_T×_H H_i is another such pullback. Mathlib uniqueness of limit objects supplies their comparison isomorphism; its projection lemmas give exactly the two equations in the statement. Sectionwise this is (a,(x,y))↦(a,y), with inverse (a,y)↦(a,(t(a),y)).

source.place: Tag 041F (lemma-etale), part (3), omitted proof; details supplied here from the sheaf and scheme-test definitions.

proof.text: Apply the scheme-test definition [def-trf-algebraic-space] of IsEtale(h_i) to t≫g, obtaining U,p,q and an étale p with IsPullback q (yoneda.map p) h_i (t≫g). The original explicit pullback square lifts (yoneda.map p≫t,q) to a map k:h_U→P_i. Cancel that explicit square from the representing square to obtain IsPullback k (yoneda.map p) π_i t. Thus π_i is representable étale. If e:G≅h_T is a representing isomorphism, test this property along e.inv:h_T→G. In the resulting pullback the bottom map is an isomorphism, so the top map h_U→P_i is an isomorphism. Its inverse represents P_i.

source.place: Tag 041F (lemma-etale), part (3), omitted proof; details supplied here from the sheaf and scheme-test definitions.

proof.text: Let $K,s,x$ be as in the statement. Apply [def-trf-algebraic-space-jointly-surjective-family] to the element $g_K(x)\in H(\operatorname{Spec}K,s)$. The hypothesis gives $i$, a field embedding $e:K\to M$, and $y\in H_i(\operatorname{Spec}M,s\circ\operatorname{Spec}e)$ with $h_i(y)=g_K(x)|_M$. Naturality of $g$ says $g_M(x|_M)=g_K(x)|_M$. Therefore $p=(x|_M,y)$ satisfies the defining equality of $P_i(\operatorname{Spec}M)$ and $\pi_i(p)=x|_M$. This is exactly the extension-lifting condition for joint surjectivity of $(\pi_i)$ in the cited definition. The extension itself witnesses equality of the projected point class with the class of $x$.

source.place: Tag 03BU (definition-points), preceding presheaf point equivalence; Tag 03H4 (lemma-points-cartesian), common-extension proof.

proof.text: If $I=\varnothing$ and a field-valued point $x$ of $G$ existed, $g_K(x)$ would be a field-valued point of $H$. The hypothesis in [def-trf-algebraic-space-jointly-surjective-family] applied to it would supply an element $i\in\varnothing$, a contradiction. Hence $G$ has no such points, and the universal extension-lifting assertion for the empty pulled-back family holds vacuously. This includes the empty base scheme.

lean.statement: theorem presheafPullback_etale_point_lifting {S : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type w} (G H : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u)) (Hᵢ : I → Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u)) (g : G.obj ⟶ H.obj) (h : ∀ i : I, (Hᵢ i).obj ⟶ H.obj) (he : ∀ i : I, IsEtale (h i)) : (∀ i : I, Presheaf.IsSheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (sheafPullbackCone g (h i)).pt) ∧ (∀ (i : I) (T : Over S) (t : yoneda.obj T ⟶ G.obj), (∃ e : (sheafPullbackCone t (sheafPullbackCone g (h i)).fst).pt ≅ (sheafPullbackCone (t ≫ g) (h i)).pt, e.hom ≫ (sheafPullbackCone (t ≫ g) (h i)).fst = (sheafPullbackCone t (sheafPullbackCone g (h i)).fst).fst ∧ e.hom ≫ (sheafPullbackCone (t ≫ g) (h i)).snd = (sheafPullbackCone t (sheafPullbackCone g (h i)).fst).snd ≫ (sheafPullbackCone g (h i)).snd) ∧ ∃ (U : Over S) (p : U ⟶ T) (q : yoneda.obj U ⟶ (Hᵢ i).obj), IsPullback q (yoneda.map p) (h i) (t ≫ g) ∧ Etale p.left) ∧ (∀ i : I, IsEtale (sheafPullbackCone g (h i)).fst) ∧ (∀ (i : I) (T : Over S) (_ : G.obj ≅ yoneda.obj T), ∃ U : Over S, Nonempty ((sheafPullbackCone g (h i)).pt ≅ yoneda.obj U)) ∧ (IsJointlySurjective h → (∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] (s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S) (x : G.obj.obj (op (Over.mk s))), ∃ (i : I) (M : Type u) (_ : Field M) (e : K →+* M) (y : (Hᵢ i).obj.obj (op (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e) ≫ s)))), (h i).app _ y = H.obj.map (Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e)) rfl).op (g.app _ x) ∧ ∃ p : (sheafPullbackCone g (h i)).pt.obj (op (Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e) ≫ s))), p.val = (G.obj.map (Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e)) rfl).op x, y) ∧ (sheafPullbackCone g (h i)).fst.app _ p = G.obj.map (Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e)) rfl).op x) ∧ IsJointlySurjective (fun i : I ↦ (sheafPullbackCone g (h i)).fst) ∧ (IsEmpty I → ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] (s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S), IsEmpty (G.obj.obj (op (Over.mk s)))))
